DDL	CREATE TABLE t1(col1 INT, col2 STRING)
DDL	CREATE TABLE t2(col1 INT)
DDL	CREATE TABLE t3(col1 INT, col2 STRING)
READ	SELECT *
READ	SELECT *
READ	SELECT *
READ	SELECT col1 IN (SELECT col1 FROM t2)
READ	SELECT col1 FROM t2 GROUP BY col1 IN (SELECT col1 FROM t2), col1 ORDER BY col1 IN (SELECT col1 FROM t2)
READ	SELECT col1 FROM t2 GROUP BY col1 ORDER BY 1 IN (SELECT 1)
READ	SELECT col1 AS a, a + 1 FROM t2 GROUP BY col1 ORDER BY 1 IN (SELECT 1)
DDL	DROP TABLE t1
DDL	DROP TABLE t2
DDL	DROP TABLE t3
